snippet.title: Midnight Horde - The Mix Fall Showcase 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Midnight Horde here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/864170/Midnight_Horde/

Leap, slash, and soar through gothic ruins in Midnight Horde, a high-mobility auto shooter where parkour meets reverse bullet hell. Battle through swarms of monstrosities, upgrade deadly weapons, and build strongholds to push back the creeping dark.

Find out more here:
https://midnighthorde.com/
